Each identity posts a knoll: a 0.50-unit escrow tagged to its origin. Only 2 oasis slots open per origin per epoch.

The dawn is the 12-epoch lock from registration: escrow frozen, weight 0. After it, admitted identities get weight 1. Excess deposits enter a withdrawal queue releasing one 0.50-unit escrow per epoch, less a 40% fee.

An attacker funding N identities from one origin posts 0.50N units. Only 2 win slots; the other N-2 exit at 0.30 each. Recovery = 1.00 + 0.30(N-2), so loss = 0.20N - 0.40. At N=10: pay 5.00, recover 3.40, buy 2 votes.
